PROJECT MANAGER

IPAD STORAGE / BACKUPS

Projects stay in memory until you export them to the Files app. No browser project storage is used. For a durable copy outside Safari, export a ZIP and save it in the Files app.
No Google Drive connection or sync. Save a ZIP or JSON to Files before closing TerraTrace; unsaved edits will be lost.

DATA / IMPORT

Import local GIS files using the iPad Files picker, or a CORS-enabled GeoJSON URL. Large SHP/GDB/GPKG may need a server-side tile service.

GIS DATA HUB / CORRIDOR

☁ SHARED GIS DATA HUB · INDEXED FLATGEOBUF
Search indexed FlatGeobuf files in Cloudflare R2 by GIS category and your selected corridor. No manual file selection or local GIS database required.
GIS is shared read-only across signed-in companies. The GIS source token stays inside your Enterprise Cloudflare Worker.
Connect GIS to load the available R2 FlatGeobuf categories.
Select categories, then tap one KMZ/CAD alignment or one area center. Search uses the entire selected line or circular area at your radius.
Pick Line: tap any part of a project KMZ / CAD line to select its entire alignment. Pick Area: tap one location to search a circular area using the buffer radius. Select categories and search.

LOADED GIS LAYERS
Show, hide, or remove GIS results by category. This affects this project only, not your Cloudflare R2 source files.

KMZ CENTERLINE / PI EXPORT

Choose CAD Points to export all standalone CAD points, or Vertices and tap a CAD / CL / imported KMZ line to export every vertex on that line.
Select a KMZ centerline first. Counts bends by rounded-up angle: 0–30°, 31–45°, and 46–90°.
Tap Export CL, then tap near the end you want as BEGIN. PI markers appear on the selected line only. Export includes coordinates, station, bearings, and bend angles.

HDD / BORE DESIGN

Opens the full HDD creek / ROW calculator without leaving your TerraTrace map.

CAD

STATIONING

Pick a centerline, then Set Stationing. Labels appear every 200 ft and at each PI. Station equations are applied.
Enter BACK and AHEAD stations (e.g. 12+50 and 15+00). No map selection required. The BACK station locates the equation along the edited centerline; AHEAD sets downstream stationing.

Enterprise rollout checklist

Add company workspace

Creating a workspace here does not create a Cloudflare tenant or send an invitation.

Workspace controls

Enable or suspend a company in the setup plan. Actual access restrictions must later be enforced by the project API.

Workspace IDs are permanent identifiers used to scope projects. Avoid reusing IDs across clients.

Companies

Add user assignment

This is a role assignment plan, not an invitation or login account.

Suggested permissions

Company Admin: users and projects within their company

Management: create projects, edit ownership, link documents

Field Crew: open assigned projects, add tract notes

Viewer: read-only project access

The true Super Admin role should be controlled by the identity service, never granted through this client-side form.

User assignments

Assign a project to a company

Assignments here are planning metadata; production cloud projects are not moved, renamed, or permissioned.

Project isolation design

The future API must authorize both the company and project for every list, open, save, and sync operation.

Suggested object key: companies/{companyId}/projects/{projectId}

Never trust company IDs supplied by a browser unless they match the verified user's membership.
